class: An unsupported pause control acknowledges success and sends a command with opposite semantics
symptom: The cockpit Pause endpoint claimed paused while writing refresh to existing review signals, which can resume a waiting worker.
root_cause: The UI exposed pause without a cooperative runtime pause implementation and reused the refresh command despite its progression semantics.
why_tests_missed: The control test asserted HTTP success and an ok flag without verifying the worker command or resulting behavior.
fix: Disable the unavailable control and refuse stale-client pause requests without writing any signal. Show the refusal if an old client still invokes the endpoint.
prevention: Expose runtime controls only after their command semantics and observed effects are implemented; assert that a pause can never authorize progression.
